cands.name: Mike Elliott

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member-elect of the Alabama House of Representatives, District 13. He defeated incumbent Greg Barnes in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary and was unopposed in the November 3, 2026 general election. Earlier work and career are not documented in the sources reviewed.
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Mike Elliott was born or raised, when he came to Alabama, or what his career has been. We found no record of earlier elected office. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and we found no campaign statements on data centers, property taxes, development, immigration, guns, abortion, schools, policing or campaign donations. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or endorsements. Ballotpedia says he withdrew or was disqualified from a 2025 special Republican primary for the same seat, and we found no explanation of why.
